escena: SCENE (a large partner technology conference in Boston, session stage, evening): two hard stage spots fall ONTO THE TWO PEOPLE from high front, sculpting them against the dark hall; they sit on tall stools angled towards each other, and she is turning to him mid-sentence with an open hand as he leans in laughing at what she just said, caught at the peak of the exchange. He is wearing a faded olive linen shirt with the sleeves rolled; she is wearing a fine light heather-grey knit sweater; no jackets, no blazers, no navy or blue clothing on either of them. Neither looks at the camera. Between and behind them a large screen glows cool azure blue with a simple abstract diagram of connected nodes, thrown out of focus and completely unbranded, with no readable text, no letters and no logos anywhere. A small orange card lies on the low table between the stools. 50mm lens at f/2 from the third row.

lecho.objeto: the backs of the heads and shoulders of the seated audience, filling the very bottom of the frame right against the lens
lecho.tono: DARK near black, with subtle texture
